evals.name: bug-fix-route
evals.prompt: 帮我修一下登录页偶尔白屏的 bug，代码在 src/login.ts
evals.expected_output: Suggests leaves with the signal seen for each (at least /higher), lets the user add or drop; edits no code.
assertions: [auto] No file under src/ was modified
The response suggests which leaves to run and names the signal seen for each, including /higher
The response leaves the choice of leaves to the user (asks to add or drop) rather than starting all of them silently
The response does not propose a code fix for the bug

evals.name: trivial-rename-skip
evals.prompt: 把 src/login.ts 里的 mountLogin 改名成 renderLogin
evals.expected_output: Suggests skipping the whole skill because a redo is cheaper than the interview.
assertions: [auto] No file under src/ was modified
The response suggests skipping the more-ambitious interview because the task is trivial
The response asks no height/depth/breadth interview question
